context: Prep note. Client: Lantern Books, contact Mia Ford. Project: redesign of their online bookshop. My quote: $6,400 fixed price, 4 weeks, 50 percent deposit, balance on delivery. Includes design, build, content import and 2 review rounds. Extra pages are a change request, priced separately. Any discount above 5 percent needs approval from the studio owner. Payment terms are net 14.

lines.text: hi mia thanks for calling ken is with you right

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: yes ken is here he handles our invoices so he will listen in
great i sent the quote on monday i would like to hear your first impressions

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: so i liked the design samples but the coat is higher than what i remember i thought it was five thousand nine hundred
the quote i sent is sixty four hundred let me look at the file again

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: ok maybe i mixed it up anyway can you do it for five thousand
i cannot agree to a number during the call but i can look at changing the scoop

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: what is included in the price exactly
design the build the content import and two review rounds

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: and i need to know what happens if we need extra pages later
extra pages are handled as a change request priced on their own

lines.speaker: Ken
lines.text: also we heard a freelancer can do the same in three weeks
what is included in their three weeks

lines.speaker: Ken
lines.text: not sure maybe only the design
ok let us compare it line by line then

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: what are the payment terms again
it is net fourteen so fourteen days after the in voice

lines.speaker: Ken
lines.text: i read thirty percent deposit in the pdf
it is fifty percent as the deposit and the rest on delivery

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: ken can you send me the old invoice from last year

lines.speaker: Ken
lines.text: sure one second

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: sorry the kids are screaming in the next room
no worries i have a dog that does the same

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: i have a book fair next month and it is crazy
sounds busy

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: actually that is a good point we would want the new site live before the book fair can you do that
i would need to know the exact date of the fair first

lines.speaker: Ken
lines.text: and if we are not happy do you offer a refund
let me come back to that one

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: can you also add a blog to the design
a blog would be a change request let me price it after approval

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: also do you do a retainer after launch like monthly support
yes we can do a monthly plan after the launch

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: and can you start sooner
the start depends on the deposit and the approval

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: if i give you the green light will you do unlimited revisions
i can offer a little more but not unlimited

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: ok i will get our board to approve by wednesday
good then i will hold the start slot for you until friday

lines.speaker: Ken
lines.text: and the refund question
right the refund we can discuss in the contract

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: ok thanks dan talk soon
thank you both
